audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].why and breakdown.early both open with 'Q-empowered autos with the blade behind him win trades' while the same row rates Level 1 as Urgot's. The page argues Shen wins the level it marks as lost.
audit.why: Corrosive Charge (Q) is an 800-range explosive with a slow; Twilight Assault (Q) is 400 range and Shen has no W or E at level 1. Urgot pokes for free.
audit.corrected: Level 1 is Urgot's on range: last-hit at Twilight Assault range, keep the blade as a buffer, and do not step into Corrosive Charge.

audit.why: Spikes are stated as Lvl 3 (full pattern), Lvl 6 (Stand United), 1st item, and an enemy spike at Lvl 2-3. Urgot's own spikes (Disdain online, 6, first item) are recorded in breakdown.spikes. All four spikes[] entries exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page states that Stand United's channel can be interrupted. Urgot has two interrupts: Disdain (E, 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, hard CC displacement) and Fear Beyond Death (R, 100/85/70s, hard CC).
audit.why: Shen's R is flagged 'channel — interruptible; any CC cancels it' with a 200/180/160s cooldown. Losing it to a 14s E is the single most punishing interaction in the matchup and is absent from every field.
audit.corrected: Never channel Stand United inside Disdain range; channel only after his E is spent, or from behind the wave.

audit.why: Disdain is correctly named as the punishable cooldown; its real value is 16s at rank 1 down to 14s at rank 5.
Both suspectNames flagged in the packet ('Use Stand United', 'Land Corrosive Charge') are FALSE POSITIVES — both match the kit files exactly. No fabricated ability names found in this matchup.
